headline: BRUR expels 11 people, including 3 teachers, over Shaheed Abu Sayed killing
summary: The university has taken disciplinary action against staff and faculty members linked to the death of student Abu Sayed.
details: The Begum Rokeya University, Rangpur (BRUR) has expelled 11 individuals, including three teachers, for their alleged involvement in the killing of student Abu Sayed.
The action was taken as part of a university investigation into the events surrounding the death of the student during the protests.
The expelled individuals include faculty members and other university staff who were found to be linked to the student's death.
This move comes amidst ongoing efforts to ensure accountability for those responsible for the violence against students during the recent unrest.

headline: BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty resigns from parliament following PM's directive
summary: Ferdousi Ahmed Misty, a BNP MP representing a reserved seat, has submitted her resignation to the Speaker of Parliament. The move comes after her name surfaced in connection with an incident at the Radda Health Centre.
details: Ferdousi Ahmed Misty, a Member of Parliament from the BNP for a reserved seat, has submitted her resignation letter to the Speaker of the National Parliament. This action follows allegations linking her to an incident of vandalism at the Radda Health Centre.

The Election Commission has stated that a by-election will need to be held within 90 days to fill the vacancy created by Misty's resignation. The Speaker has confirmed the acceptance of her resignation, officially declaring her parliamentary seat vacant.

While the Home Minister has stated that legal action will be taken if allegations against Misty are proven, he also claimed to be unaware of her resignation. The BNP has indicated that they will adhere to whatever decision the party makes regarding the matter.
caption:
BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty resigns from parliament after allegations of involvement in vandalism at Radda Health Centre.

Ferdousi Ahmed Misty, a Member of Parliament from the BNP for a reserved seat, has submitted her resignation letter to the Speaker of the National Parliament. This action follows allegations linking her to an incident of vandalism at the Radda Health Centre.

While the Home Minister has stated that legal action will be taken if allegations against Misty are proven, he also claimed to be unaware of her resignation. The BNP has indicated that they will adhere to whatever decision the party makes regarding the matter.
